package.description: Desktop app for AI-generated raster slide decks where the prompt is the only editable artifact.

en-US.description: Desktop app for AI-generated raster slide decks where the prompt is the only editable artifact.
en-US.longDescription:
Substrate generates raster slide decks with an image model. The only editable
artifacts are two prompts (a per-slide prompt and a deck-level main design
prompt) which both a human (in the UI) and an agent (over MCP) can co-author.
en-US.name: Substrate
